admission.justification: The attributed source owners must agree on the same selection, receipt and identity contract; a single location cannot preserve the obligation across its public producer and consumers.

applicability: The dashboard’s selected sprint/master Investigator request.
conditions: The persisted request UUID is restored and supplied with full document references for Result/report, Retry and Revive.
Remount retains that selection even if a newer sibling exists.
exclusions: The primary Manager or Orchestrator remains the selected document chat.
Earlier Projects storage addresses and uncertain retries retain their meaning.

evidence: A02.browser.txt; DocumentChat.test.tsx mounted sprint/master backend-shaped executions[] cases, all request bodies and primary-chat assertions

statement: Selected sprint/master Investigators use their exact persisted request identity for restore, automatic and manual Result, report access, Retry and Revive while the panel primary remains its Manager or Orchestrator.
